title: Component Symbols and Pins
text:
Catalog of supported schematic symbols and their pins:
- resistor: 1, 2
- potentiometer: 1, 2, W
- capacitor: 1, 2
- capacitor_polarized: +, -
- variable_capacitor: 1, 2
- inductor: 1, 2
- coupled_inductor: 1A, 1B, 2A, 2B
- transformer: P1, P2, S1, S2
- diode: A, K
- zener_diode: A, K
- schottky_diode: A, K
- led: A, K
- vcvs: +, -, CP+, CP-
- vccs: +, -, CP+, CP-
- ccvs: +, -, S+, S-
- cccs: +, -, S+, S-
- opamp_741: IN+, IN-, OUT, V+, V-
- npn: B, C, E
- pnp: B, E, C
- nmos: G, D, S
- pmos: G, S, D
- njfet: G, D, S
- pjfet: G, S, D
- switch_spst: 1, 2
- switch_spdt: C, A, B
- relay_spst: COIL+, COIL-, 1, 2
- fuse: 1, 2
- connector_2: 1, 2
- connector_3: 1, 2, 3
- test_point: 1
- ground: 0
- power_port: 1
- audio_in: +, -
- audio_out: 1
- net_label: 1
- sub_block: (dynamic pins)
- voltage_source: +, -
- current_source: +, -
- ac_voltage_source: +, -
- ac_current_source: +, -
- oscilloscope_2ch: CH1, CH2, REF
- digital_multimeter: HI, LO
- bode_analyzer: IN, OUT, REF

Use these exact symbol IDs when calling schematic_place_symbol. Use these exact pin names when calling schematic_connect.
